label: sec:archimedean-condition-leptons-preamble
html: The preceding sub-section stated the Descartes condition \chi = -6 and proved that its descent chain forces a maximally-descended genus. This sub-section extracts the immediate physical consequences: the lepton spectrum, the chirality assignment that distinguishes leptons from anti-leptons, the affine-light-cone parameterisation underlying the chirality measurement, and the trefoil-chirality correspondence that anchors the chirality assignment in braid data. The Brings-curve block closes the sub-section by pointing forward to the genus-completeness derivation that the next sub-section unfolds.
